implementation: Added independent LessonValidationService and immutable LessonValidation/ValidatedLesson lifecycle. Failed validation cannot create lessons; validated lessons bind candidate digest, evidence, scope, confidence and expiry; expiration and revocation are explicit and separate from candidate state.

tests.full_result: 823 contract, 9 property, 2 schema, 1 unit passed; ruff, mypy, secret scan, health passed
